clips.title: The story
paras: At the Wetlands dig, Flagongut seeks answers in an ancient fossil. The Explorers' League keeps the specimen, and Flagongut believes the Stone of Relu can help him decipher its secrets.

Prospector Whelgar keeps the fossil at his excavation site in the southern hills of the Wetlands. Dwarven expeditions across Khaz Modan unearthed it, and Archaeologist Flagongut believes its ancient stone holds forgotten powers. He sees a kinship with artifacts found across the sea in Darkshore.
